description: This file manages the copying and bundling of plugin metadata, including skills, extensions, and related package files. It handles file system operations like directory reading, file copying with retries, and JSON transformations for plugin packaging.

methods.name: rewritePackageExtensions
methods.description: Rewrites a list of package extension entries to standardize their format with '.js' extensions.

methods.name: collectTopLevelPublicSurfaceEntries
methods.description: Collects top-level JavaScript, TypeScript, or CoffeeScript files in a plugin directory, excluding test, spec, fixture, or snapshot files.

methods.name: isManifestlessBundledRuntimeSupportPackage
methods.description: Determines if a package is a manifestless bundled runtime support package based on its name and surface entries.

methods.name: rewritePackageEntry
methods.description: Normalizes and rewrites a package entry string to a module path with '.js' extension.

methods.name: ensurePathInsideRoot
methods.description: Ensures a given path is within a specified root directory, resolving and checking for path traversal.

methods.name: normalizeManifestRelativePath
methods.description: Normalizes path strings to use forward slashes and removes leading './'.

methods.name: resolveDeclaredSkillSourcePath
methods.description: Resolves the absolute path to a declared skill source, handling node_modules paths and ensuring path is within repo root.

methods.name: resolveBundledSkillTarget
methods.description: Resolves the target path for a bundled skill, relocating node_modules paths to the designated bundled directory.

methods.name: isTransientCopyError
methods.description: Checks if an error is a transient copy error based on its code.

methods.name: sleepSync
methods.description: Performs a synchronous sleep using Atomics.wait for retry delays.

methods.name: copySkillPathWithRetry
methods.description: Copies a skill path with retry logic on transient errors, using configured retry delays.

methods.name: copyDeclaredPluginSkillPaths
methods.description: Copies all declared skills from a plugin manifest, handling path resolution and filtering nested node_modules.

methods.name: copyBundledPluginMetadata
methods.description: Main function that copies plugin metadata and skills, managing directory structures, file transformations, and cleanup.
